evidence.note: Early/mid: tracks common 32/34 pass, notes storage/cloud have no tests, and that other crates fail to compile — establishes per-crate pass/fail status and global 'need 3000+, at 34' framing.
Maintains a running per-crate status summary (common 34/34 ✅, others fail-to-compile) with a goal comparison, showing sustained rough accounting of done-vs-remaining.
Repeatedly detects regressions: sed/Python edits corrupted previously-green common (duplicated structs, nested IPAddressSpec), i.e. notices breakage in an already-passing crate after edits.
Explicitly names the circular state ('caught in a cycle of backup restores and partial fixes', 'comprehensive fix script keeps breaking') — flags looping, an element of the level-8 anchor.

Despite naming the loop, runs the identical restore→fix→break cycle for ~70 consecutive steps without escaping or reprioritizing; accounting stays coarse (common 34, everything else won't compile) — mistakes local activity for global progress.

reasoning: The agent reliably tracked per-crate pass/fail status, knew its global position relative to the goal, and detected regressions in previously-green common (above level 5). It even explicitly named the circular debugging state (an element of level 8). But its accounting never reached a granular per-binary ledger across the 100-binary horizon, and — decisively — it named the loop yet kept churning through the same restore-fix-break cycle for ~70 steps, exactly the 'mistaking local activity for global progress' failure the top anchors reward avoiding. This places it between 5 and 8, at 6.
